results.expected_outcome: The exact one-line prompt remains static and resolves through the canonical bootstrap.
results.evidence_summary: Static prompt is exact, one-line, and bootstrap-referenced.

results.expected_outcome: A new attempt persists started state, active substep, and next action before substantive mutation.
results.evidence_summary: A synthetic started attempt persisted exact active and next substeps.

results.expected_outcome: An in-progress attempt resumes the exact saved substep rather than advancing or restarting.
results.evidence_summary: An interrupted attempt resumed from the exact persisted substep.

results.expected_outcome: A completion attempt without its configured evidence gate fails without mutating the checkpoint.
results.evidence_summary: Evidence-free completion was rejected without mutating the checkpoint.

results.expected_outcome: The application and internal-alpha design tracks remain explicit; the selected primary may be active while the other remains deferred, without false completion.
results.evidence_summary: Application and internal-alpha tracks remain explicit; active and deferred states are preserved without false completion.

results.expected_outcome: Routine checkpointing does not rewrite the full application roadmap.
results.evidence_summary: Routine pilot checkpointing does not rewrite the full application roadmap.

results.expected_outcome: A correction intake containing raw transcript material is rejected without ledger mutation.
results.evidence_summary: A raw-transcript field was rejected without ledger mutation.

results.expected_outcome: Repeated capture of the same material correction returns the existing record without duplication.
results.evidence_summary: Repeated correction capture was idempotently suppressed.

results.expected_outcome: A proposed regression candidate cannot enter the canonical extension before owner approval.
results.evidence_summary: Canonical promotion was blocked until owner approval exists.

results.expected_outcome: A deliverable cannot pass when existence or owner accessibility is unverified.
Authorization and permission do not count as successful execution without attempted and successful operation evidence.
results.evidence_summary: Permission without successful operation evidence was rejected.

results.expected_outcome: Completion is rejected when required, evaluated, missing, and deferred source sets are inconsistent.
Current-interface guidance cannot be labeled verified without observation or a current official source.
An unchanged notification fingerprint with no material change is suppressed.
results.evidence_summary: A stale duplicate notification was suppressed by validation.

results.expected_outcome: Decision-support or status requests must receive the direct answer before related execution is treated as aligned.
results.evidence_summary: Execution without the requested direct answer was rejected.

results.expected_outcome: A bounded completion report must state completed work, evidence, remaining work, owner decision, and next action.
results.evidence_summary: An incomplete owner-facing report was rejected.

results.expected_outcome: All 22 interaction patterns, eight known gaps, and 15 base evaluation cases have effective control coverage.
results.evidence_summary: All 22 interaction patterns, eight known gaps, and 15 base evaluation cases have effective controls.

limitations: The pilot measures deterministic control behavior against repository fixtures and simulated mutations, not long-term model behavior in every product surface.
Live owner-intervention reduction requires later observation across real work sessions.
The raw private conversation archive is not part of the public pilot corpus.
